_comment: Country codes printed on carrier rate cards that are not ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. iso_code = the ISO country the territory belongs to (null when ISO has no code). Found in B1C04 zone sheets.

B1C04.name: Canary Islands
B1C04.note: Spanish islands priced separately from mainland Spain; IC is only an ISO 'exceptionally reserved' code

B1C04.name: Kosovo
B1C04.note: XK is the code in common use; it is user-assigned, not official ISO

B1C04.name: Bonaire
B1C04.note: Part of BQ (Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba)

B1C04.name: St. Eustatius
B1C04.note: Part of BQ (Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba)

B1C04.name: Nevis
B1C04.note: Part of Saint Kitts and Nevis

B1C04.name: Somalia (Hargeisa)
B1C04.note: Somaliland region, priced separately from the rest of Somalia
